tasks.label: prepare-repository-upload
tasks.command: $git='C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe'; & $git -C 'd:\leaflogic' init --initial-branch=main; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & $git -C 'd:\leaflogic' remote add origin 'https://github.com/DharmikRavat/leaflogic-.git'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & $git -C 'd:\leaflogic' add -A; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & $git -C 'd:\leaflogic' status --short; & $git -C 'd:\leaflogic' diff --cached --stat
